params.name: service_type
params.description: Filter by service type (chatbot, text-to-image, speech-to-text)

params.name: model
params.description: Filter by on-chain model ID (e.g. zai-org/GLM-5.1-FP8); exact model_id match. Empty = not filtered.

params.name: canonical_id
params.description: [beta] Filter by canonical model ID (e.g. glm-5.1); lists every endpoint serving that canonical. Composes (AND) with model. Empty = not filtered.

items.docs: Get all TEE-acknowledged providers, optionally narrowed by service type, on-chain model id, and/or canonical id. `model` and `canonical_id` are independent filters and compose (ANDed): `canonical_id` alone lists every endpoint of a canonical, while `model` + `canonical_id` narrows to a specific endpoint within it. An empty value means "not filtered on" (so no filters = list all). Includes providers with unknown health status (is_healthy=null).
